messages:
sudha: FYI p95 for /v1/generate jumped ~300ms at ~08:20 UTC. Dashboard shows a merged p95, not per-destination. Is this expected after the quota routing tweak?

alex: saw it. looks correlated with the new quota spill policy that routes to 'fallback-small' once reserve exhausted. fallback-small has slower cold-starts and narrower batch efficiency.

maria: are we sure the dashboard p95 is using the ingress sampling stream? last time we discovered our UI percentiles were coming from the router-sampled telemetry not the per-endpoint rollups. sampling + spillover routing could skew p95.

ryan: correct — current pipeline: router -> sample stream (1%) -> traces service -> ui. The long-tail requests from fallback likely get under-sampled differently because they hit during bursts.

sudha: ugh. so two problems: (1) percentiles shown are from sampled data, (2) routing changes change the sample distribution. both can make p95 look worse even if per-endpoint rollups didn't change.

alex: quick check: I ran a promql-ish query on the rollups: ``hist_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(req_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, endpoint))`` per-endpoint p95 is flat. merged p95 (no endpoint label) moves.

maria: that matches my theory. UI merges rollups by summing histograms across endpoints but we also have a separate sampled trace store used by the latency panel for speed. two different sources.

ryan: Proposal: add a small badge on latency charts that says "source: sampled traces" or "source: aggregated rollups" plus show sample_count. should be quick UX and helps investigations.

sudha: Agreed. Also recommend we expose a toggle to switch the panel to "per-endpoint" aggregation by default for /v1/* routes. Those endpoints have distinct performance profiles and quotas.

alex: Implementation note: per-endpoint rollups exist, but the UI fetch currently requests "merged" when route filter is wildcard. We can change default to request rollups grouped by endpoint when route wildcard is used for first-class endpoints. Edge-case: for thousands of endpoints that might be expensive.

maria: For scalability we could: (a) show top N endpoints by traffic + an "other" bucket, (b) lazy-load more endpoints on demand. Also include sample_count so p95 is interpretable.

ryan: Longer term: add metadata to t-digest rollups with sample_origin label (router-sampled vs local-rollup) so the UI can align sources. That requires ingestion change but preserves exactness.

sudha: For immediate action items: 1) add badge + sample_count to UI (alex), 2) default to top-10 per-endpoint view when wildcard routes (maria + alex), 3) add an internal doc explaining how quota routing affects sampled telemetry (sudha).

alex: I'll open a PR for the badge and sample_count metric in the chart component. small front-end + API param.

maria: I'll prototype the top-N endpoint panel and the lazy-loading behavior. I'll also add a tooltip that explains sample biases (short blurb).

ryan: I'll draft the ingestion change proposal for adding sample_origin to t-digests and estimate infra cost.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: ui/latency-badge v0.1 -> staging at 1725011400

sudha: thanks all. if we see another spike, let's post raw per-endpoint numbers into this thread for quick triage. :thumbsup:
